subject: Bug: crashes rather than warns PSRF not calculable with 1 chain

messages.author: b92327f206542ca8
messages.subject: Bug: crashes rather than warns PSRF not calculable with 1 chain
parts:
blavaan should be able to run normally when using only 1 chain; in
this case, the PSRF for variables can't be calculated because there
are no other chains to compare to in order to assess convergence, so a
warning should be printed and no PSRFs reported, but instead, blavaan
HEAD crashes. With `n.chains=2`, blavaan still is unable to calculate
PSRF, but does print a warning and without crashing. `n.chains=1`
should behave like `n.chains=2`.

Demonstration:

R> library(blavaan)
Loading required package: runjags
Loading required package: lavaan
This is lavaan 0.5-20
lavaan is BETA software! Please report any bugs.
This is blavaan 0.1-4.39
blavaan is more BETA than lavaan!
R> ?bsem
R> model <- '
+ # latent variable definitions
+ ind60 =~ x1 + x2 + x3
+ dem60 =~ y1 + a*y2 + b*y3 + c*y4
+ dem65 =~ y5 + a*y6 + b*y7 + c*y8
+
+ # regressions
+ dem60 ~ ind60
+ dem65 ~ ind60 + dem60
+
+ # residual correlations
+ y1 ~~ y5
+ y2 ~~ y4 + y6
+ y3 ~~ y7
+ y4 ~~ y8
+ y6 ~~ y8
+ '

R> fit <- bsem(model, data=PoliticalDemocracy,
dp=dpriors(nu="dnorm(5,1e-2)"), n.chains=1)
Found more than one class "Model" in cache; using the first, from
namespace 'lavaan'

R> summary(fit)
Error in summary(fit) : object 'fit' not found
